description:
My Property Box are delighted to welcome this recently fully renovated two bedroom apartment to the rental market. Offered on an unfurnished basis and available from December, this beautifully presented property is ideal for professionals, couples, or individuals seeking stylish, modern living in a convenient location.

Recently renovated throughout to a high standard, the apartment boasts a fresh, contemporary interior, spacious accommodation, and an abundance of natural light. The property briefly comprises a bright and welcoming living area, a modern fitted kitchen offering ample storage, two well-proportioned bedrooms, and a stylish bathroom finished with modern fixtures and fittings.

Situated in a highly sought-after location, the apartment benefits from easy access to a fantastic range of local amenities, including shops, supermarkets, cafés, restaurants, and bars. Excellent transport links are also close by, providing convenient access to the city centre and surrounding areas, making this an ideal choice for those seeking both comfort and convenience.

Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the quality of the renovation, contemporary accommodation, and desirable location this fantastic apartment has to offer.
